notes.title: Chapter 2: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
It’s finally here!!! The adventure begins on November 8, 2024, when "The Strange Story of Brian Fisher" unlocks its doors. Get ready to unravel secrets and escape the unknown in this thrilling story-driven escape room experience! This Friday we are releasing on Xbox, Microsoft Store, and Steam!!!

notes.title: Release Trailer
notes.notes:
With great honor and excitement, we are presenting the release trailer for the first chapter of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1165840/The_Strange_Story_Of_Brian_Fisher_Chapter_1/]"The Strange Story of Brian Fisher"[/url] where you will be playing as Brian, who is struggling with the disappearance of his father and is caught in some strange situations.

We hope you will enjoy it and wait for the end of the month to dive into the mystery…

See you all in Redstone County on April 29th, 2020!!!
